stem: Staff move from an isolation area directly into clean propagation space using the same tools and clothing. What is the strongest systems critique?
choices: The workflow collapses clean/dirty zoning and can move pests or pathogens into high-value clean stock
The workflow is efficient because it reduces walking
The risk exists only if plants have visible symptoms
Tool cleaning is unnecessary if rooms share HVAC
rationale: Biosecurity depends on directional workflow, sanitation boundaries and controls that reduce transfer from higher-risk to cleaner zones.
